content_sections.heading: About MTU
content_sections.text: Manipur Technical University, Imphal is a university established under the Manipur Technical University Act, 2016 and recognised by UGC under Section 2(f) and Section 22 of the UGC Act, 1956. This post is in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Takyelpat, Imphal. The project's Principal Investigator is Dr. Biraj Shougaijam, Assistant Professor, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Manipur Technical University, Takyelpat, Imphal, Manipur-795004.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates need one of the following: M.Tech. or M.E. degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering or equivalent; or B.Tech. or B.E. degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering or equivalent; or M.Sc. in Electronics/Physics, with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Preference will be given to candidates having research experience in the following areas: Semiconductor/optoelectronic device simulation and modelling Nanomaterial synthesis and device fabrication Electronic material characterization and analysis Other related research areas GATE or CSIR-UGC NET qualification. Candidates who have qualified GATE or CSIR-UGC NET are engaged as JRF; candidates without it are engaged as Project Associate-I. If a qualified JRF candidate is not available, a Project Associate-I may be selected from among the eligible candidates, with the applicable monthly emolument. The age limit is not more than 30 years as on the closing date of application, i.e., 27 November 2026. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates will be eligible for relaxation in age and qualification, as applicable, as per Government of India norms. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The third-year amount in both cases is subject to successful assessment and upgradation to Senior Research Fellow (SRF). HRA is paid in addition to the amounts shown; the notice does not state the HRA rate.

content_sections.text: Applications are made in the prescribed format and sent by email. The notice does not mention a website link for the form or an email subject line. Fill in the application form in the prescribed format. Scan the duly filled-in application form along with the required supporting documents. If you wish, add a brief resume/biodata with the application form. Email the scanned copies to [email protected] by 27 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of shortlisted candidates will be announced on 30 November 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend an online/offline (hybrid) interview. Date: 7 December 2026 Time: 11:00 a.m. Mode: Online/Offline (Hybrid) Venue: Conference Room, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Manipur Technical University If the interview is conducted online, candidates are expected to have a reliable internet connection and the necessary facilities to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MTU JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the MTU JRF/Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: M.Tech./M.E. or B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering or equivalent, or M.Sc. in Electronics/Physics, with at least 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. GATE or CSIR-UGC NET is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MTU JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not more than 30 years as on 27 November 2026. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates get relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the MTU JRF and Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: A JRF gets ₹37,000 + HRA per month in the 1st and 2nd years and ₹42,000 + HRA in the 3rd year; a Project Associate-I gets ₹30,000 + HRA and ₹33,000 + HRA respectively, with the 3rd-year amount subject to assessment and upgradation to SRF.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the monthly emolument?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives every pay figure as the amount plus HRA per month, for example ₹37,000 + HRA for a JRF.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email scanned copies of the duly filled-in application form in the prescribed format, with the required supporting documents, to [email protected] by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the MTU JRF post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates, announced on 30 November 2026, attend an online/offline (hybrid) interview on 7 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MTU JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary, renewable annually subject to satisfactory performance for a maximum of three years, and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or for joining the post.
